name: authengentic
description: Run the authengentic linter and the review and rewrite operations from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Authengentic writes plain, human-sounding technical and professional prose. This bundle adds a deterministic linter tool and two prompts (authengentic-review, authengentic-rewrite) to the Claude Desktop chat surface, which has no post-write hook of its own. The linter is a regex pass, not a compliance verdict. It needs python3 on the machine.

tools.name: authengentic_lint
tools.description: Count deterministic authengentic violations in non-fiction text and return the JSON report plus a short verdict.

prompts.name: authengentic-review
prompts.description: Diagnose non-fiction text against the authengentic ruleset. Report only.
prompts.text: Review this text against the authengentic ruleset, report only: ${arguments.text}

prompts.name: authengentic-rewrite
prompts.description: Rewrite non-fiction text in place to follow the authengentic ruleset.
prompts.text: Rewrite this text with the authengentic refactor operation: ${arguments.text}

python_path.title: Python interpreter
python_path.description: Absolute path to a python3 interpreter. Leave blank to use python3 from PATH.
